correctness.rationale: All 6599 nonempty faces were enumerated, with explicit orientation. Rational rank of boundary 4 is exactly 1557; two prime reductions give 29,286,1134,1557,265 and the chain identity and dimensions prove the other rational ranks. Exact rational image-basis traces plus signed fixed-face traces determine the rational characters for all 22 conjugacy classes. A separate Murnaghan–Nakayama recurrence computes irreducible characters, with orthogonality and nonnegative integer inner products checked. All face boundary squares vanish. Executing verification/verify.py reproduces the complete output ending VERIFY_OK. A finite certificate is a proof for this named finite complex, not an arbitrary-size theorem.

value.rationale: The six-symbol diagonal deletion board is a natural exact matching complex at the first interesting three-primary torsion board size. Determining both full rational homology modules under its complete automorphism group is a motivated complete finite classification. The multiplicity-free seven-constituent decomposition, transpose sign changes, and one-dimensional invariant degree-four line refine previously known ranks and torsion and may guide subsequent equivariant topology. No paper-scale generalization is needed for this natural complete case.
